Browse

Find something worth doing

Spontaneous, Planned, or Committed — pick whatever fits your week, your budget, and how much notice you can give. See something you like but aren't ready for yet? Save it, and it'll be waiting for you.

Send it to someone

The best plans start with one person

Every activity has a share button that sends a friend the idea, not just a link. Skip the group chat — the people already in your week are the easiest ones to actually do something with.

Do it, then tell us how it went

A few words go a long way

Mark it done when you have. If you want, add a quick note — who you were with, how it went, any tip for the next person. Totally optional, thirty seconds tops, and it becomes part of the activity's story for whoever's next.

Share it, come back

This is what keeps it going

Post about it if you're up for it — someone else tries this because you did. Then come back whenever. There's always another one worth doing.

  • Spontaneous Do it today. Nothing to book, nothing to arrange.
  • Planned Needs a date in the diary and a bit of coordinating.
  • Committed Sign up, apply or train first — then it stays available to you.

Privacy

These are suggestions, not professional advice — use your own judgement, especially for anything involving safety, first aid, or strangers. CasuallyGenerous isn't affiliated with the organisations or businesses mentioned, and we're not responsible for what happens once you head out the door.
